what_this_is: The regional OSM extracts the discovery factory may answer Overpass cells from LOCALLY (PTF-PITTSBURGH-HARDENED-RECENSUS-001). A public Overpass server is somebody else's computer; when every approved one is down, a market's cells are answered from a committed-format index reduced from one of these extracts, with the same cache key, cell geometry and candidate contract as the Overpass path. Nothing in the code downloads an extract: an operator fetches it, verifies the checksum, and builds the index with osm_extract_cli.py. Adding a region is a row here.
provenance: Geofabrik publishes per-state extracts of OpenStreetMap under the ODbL at https://download.geofabrik.de/north-america/us.html; each *.osm.pbf has a sibling *.osm.pbf.md5. Attribution: (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0.

extracts.notes: Covers every Pittsburgh discovery cell (all fifteen lie inside Allegheny/Butler/Westmoreland counties). The index is built with the market's geographic_bounds as a bbox, so a state extract of a few hundred MB reduces to a few hundred lodging elements. data/ is gitignored: neither the extract nor the index is committed; the cells they answer are, through the discovery cache, with endpoint_id local_extract:geofabrik-pennsylvania in their provenance.

PTF-DETROIT-ANN-ARBOR-HARDENED-MEMBERSHIP-AND-SHADOW-RECENSUS-002. THE SAME Michigan extract as geofabrik-michigan -- same url, same local_pbf, same bytes (md5 acd07ad12e3cf8237c8b44b3f105d173, verified at the Detroit path before this row was added; nothing was re-downloaded). It is a SEPARATE ROW because index_path is per record and an index is reduced to ONE market's bounds: appending 'detroit-ann-arbor-mi' to the geofabrik-michigan row would have resolved Detroit's cells against the Grand Rapids index (42.75..43.15 N, -86.25..-85.45 W), which holds no Detroit element, and every Detroit cell would have come back EMPTY -- indistinguishable from a market with no lodging. Bounds here are Detroit's own committed geographic_bounds (42.05..42.75 N, -83.95..-82.90 W) from discovery/config/detroit_ann_arbor_mi.json, unchanged by that order. Provenance on every cell this answers reads endpoint_id local_extract:geofabrik-michigan-detroit-ann-arbor, so which index answered is never in doubt. data/ is gitignored: neither the extract nor the index is committed.
